scope: Seven skills, actual work XP, passions and decay, qualification checks, progress-weighted mining, crop failure, locked harvest/product quality and v14 migration. Controlled tests, normal colony campaigns and native observations are distinct evidence layers.

limitations: Seven skills only; research, backgrounds, disabled work, traits, genes, inspiration and complete environmental work-speed modifiers remain unimplemented.
Project continuous progress-weighted mining adapts native damage-weighted mining. Per-job seeded random streams are not the native global random sequence.
Work XP uses 3 native ticks per project tick while decay and midnight follow the compressed project day; existing job work amounts remain explicit adaptations.
Cooking tracks shared-task workers and rewards physical successful output; this differs from native session counters and unfinished-entity storage.
One ordinary campaign seed and its seven products do not validate the native probability distribution, long-term balance, or population scaling.
Browser checks use actual controls plus read-only snapshots and projection helpers, not screen-only inference. Native steel-knife observations are independently recorded in chapter 46.
